section.paragraph: Snapshot reconciliation check. Future input changes retain live formulas and request reconciliation rather than silently showing the old check.

Bearing stations: the notebook retains the common idealized support at 17+00.57. Physical pier bearing rows are 10.5 in either side of pier CL. Confirm end-bearing station datums and individual seat grades before using these elevations for setting out.

Local thickened deck ends remain a separate unresolved detail and quantity. Existing analysis force exports predate the revised 36-in cap and revised deck dead load; regenerate the structural analysis forces before final use of C005.

report.paragraph: BRIDGE GEOMETRY

GEOMETRY BASIS — Type F pads, 6-in pedestals and a single 36-in cap-depth input define the support stack. Use the notebook pier beam soffit and derive cap elevations, wind arms and terrain-relative heights. Verify the individual seat grades, any separate plates, retained concrete wind envelope, terrain reference and gross pier-face width against the final pier section.
WIDTH BASIS — The DXF labels 12 ft between the inside parapet faces. Handrail projections are deducted separately to determine the unobstructed walking width.
Central geometry module. Bridge dimensions used by wind, ADA, and FB-MultiPier calculations are defined here and referenced live by the other modules.

report.paragraph: Application and reinforcement notes from the supplied concept:
• Apply at deck discontinuities without full-depth diaphragms.
• Continuous deck over the interior pier: no thickening per the supplied concept.
• Top deck surface remains flat; thickening is below the normal soffit between beams.
• Thickened soffit matches the bottom of the FIB top flange, with at least 4 in. additional depth as labeled.
• Skew ≤ 15°: supplemental #5 bars plus normal top steel provide at least 2.48 in² within the thickened end.
• Skew > 15°: 8–#5 top bars parallel to skew; 7–#5 bottom bars parallel to skew; #4 distribution bars at 12 in.
• Top end reinforcement is below the normal top deck mat. For a thickened-end length greater than 2 ft 6 in., add bars at similar spacing.
• Reference-detail limits: beam spacing ≤ 14 ft and skew ≤ 35°. The drawings do not establish the project skew or a final reinforcing design.
